verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents writing custom rules for your repositories (including in the Semgrep Editor), with rule testing and taint rules described as "simple rules" for complex injection bugs. Organizations can publish private rules to the Semgrep Registry to share them across the organization. Community users confirm they write readable custom rules that easily become persistent checks. Missing for 10: cross-repo rule sharing is gated to the Team/Enterprise tier, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the sharing workflow.
